The Dragon Faire — Optional Reserve

Not on session 10's critical path. Source: The Princess and the Dragon, printed pp. 44–57 (PDF pp. 46–59). The book presents this as a separate introductory adventure. The current campaign is entering the rescue plot; do not insert a carefree festival while Amy is already trapped and the hunt is active. Main adventure: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.229394898ce8db16]{princess and dragon runbook} · Assets: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.0da13e7285047afe]{session10 asset checklist}

When to use it

Keep this in reserve. It could be a clearly labeled earlier one-shot with different characters, or an adapted post-rescue celebration if the group wants a lighter session before the castle. The latter requires Amy to be safely herself, Tifa available, and the hunt resolved. Adjust Finnian's presence to his actual outcome. A celebration is not established canon or a compulsory detour.

For a later celebration, offer 10–15 minutes of arrival, 40–60 minutes of chosen booths, a break, then 40–60 minutes for the animated statues and consequences. Pick three or four booths the PCs like rather than marching through all ten. Retain the book's normal statistics; the current party is level 3, so there is no reason to inflate the monsters automatically.

Opening and people

A runaway paper dragon brings the PCs to Amy and @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.6c421f52937e4869]{Tifa}. Amy has Powerful Friendship at level 1 and @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.0c1b326f39bb277d]{Scamp}; Tifa has Sage Intellect at level 1. The small paper dragon is a catching/problem-solving scene, not a compulsory combat.

A paper dragon loops over the crowd, its folded wings snapping like bunting. Behind it, a flustered young woman with a crown calls, “It's meant to stay inside the fairground!” From a nearby tent comes a much smaller voice: “I know!”

Amy invites the PCs to help release the paper dragons at the stage later and gives each a few tokens. Book leaves the number open; table choice: five each. Label that allowance as a GM choice. @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.6e0b038b3adbdaed]{Drakenfall Name Bank}, @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.8c64b24b4aa0ccb2]{Faire Goer}, and @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.04bc1fae868249bc]{Booth Operator} supply incidental characters. Use @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.5c03a544bd4f3ede]{Faire Wrinkles} when a complication would be fun, not a Scorchwoods hunt tick.

Booth card — choose freely

# / attraction Procedure / reward
1. Dragon's Hoard 1 SP buys 5 tokens. Redeem 1 prize ticket for a random @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.434d99fb71f24857]{Dragon Hoard Prizes} result or 3 for a selected prize. Tokens buy activities; tickets buy prizes.
2. Shooting Gallery 1 token, five crossbow shots, GRACE per shot; at least three hits wins one ticket.
3. Dragon's Lair maze Reach three successful Virtue tests. After each attempt beyond the third, d4: on 1 time expires; otherwise continue. Creative approaches can earn advantage or automatic success. Finishing wins a ticket.
4. Dragon Chiles RESOLVE per pepper; failure means you stop and become Weary. Anyone may withdraw. Last contestant wins a ticket.
5. Dragon Tails 1 token buys cherry-filled fried dough; no required test.
6. Dragon Dunk 1 token to throw; GRACE with disadvantage while hearing the heckler. A dunk wins a ticket. Addressing the heckling can remove that obstacle.
7. Build-A-Dragon Make art in any medium; impressing the operator earns a ticket. The festival traditionally burns the art at the end; tell players before they contribute something precious.
8. Dragon Stew 1 token for a taste. Identify five ingredients for each participant to win a ticket. WITS identifies one, critical success two. Smell/visual inspection usually disadvantage; smell has no disadvantage with Kitchen Magic, Cooking Talent, or a suitable sensitive nose such as Sniff. Use @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.e2bfafe5d940852c]{Stew Ingredients}.
9. Fighting Pit @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.5b4d496cc81a50b5]{Sir Finnian} accepts proposed physical contests with one hand tied behind his back. Beating him earns a ticket. Choose a relevant Virtue for the actual contest rather than inventing another attribute.
10. Main Stage Storytelling: GRACE, advantage for an appropriate Talent or a story of triumph over dragons. Audience approval earns a ticket. Three stone dragons decorate the stage.

Costs not stated in this table are not specified by the source; decide openly if necessary rather than inventing a book rule. Read item prizes from their existing table and entries.

Spotlights: Filly and Tawny can follow the paper dragon or sniff stew ingredients; Vega can solve the maze creatively or make a stone dragon artwork; Marigold can welcome a nervous Tifa and help frightened children. These are invitations, not unique keys that bar another PC from helping.

Main event: three statues wake

Amy and Tifa call the helpers to the stage. Tifa's animation spell hits the three six-foot statues instead of the hundred paper dragons. The crowd scatters. Let the PCs prioritize protecting people, luring statues, or disabling them.

Monster HP SAVE Armor Attack Special
Stone Dragon ×3 8 8 3 Bite d8 and claws d6 No breath weapon; can glide, cannot fly; cannot leave the fairground.
Statue Behavior / usable lure
Avaricious, green eyes Wants shiny things; heads toward the Hoard. Prizes are endangered there; WITS to salvage a desired item if the booth is overrun.
Voracious, orange eyes Wants food, especially meat; heads for the stew.
Barbarous, red eyes Wants a fight; remains at the stage, attacking and exploiting vulnerable targets.

Keep all three objectives visible. Finnian comes when alerted but clings to his one-handed vow until persuaded that protecting people with both hands is consistent with his honor. Do not require a secret exact phrase.

On victory, Amy celebrates the PCs and Tifa gives her journal. Tifa's Journal: Spend Time studying it to learn to cast Animate with the reader's own Gift Dice. If the statues overwhelm them, Amy calls the kingdom's knights while Tifa reverses the spell; danger need not become a campaign-ending fight. In a post-rescue adaptation, replace Amy's original offer of a parental introduction with thanks appropriate to relationships actually established in play.

Optional assets

Existing faire map, statue illustration, Amy/Tifa/Finnian art, and roll tables suffice for a simple version. Three differently colored statue markers, paper-dragon markers, token/ticket counters, and a journal handout are useful extras. No live Foundry setup is implied. See @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.0da13e7285047afe]{session10 asset checklist}; these are all low priority until this reserve is chosen.
